title: LIMEN
tagline: LIMEN is a passage between three worlds: darkness at the threshold, movement below, and sky above.
description: From a dark, compressed entrance, guests step onto a transparent floor above water and fish. Clear side walls bring the horizon into the room. Overhead, a broad charcoal roof frames a segmented glass half-dome: closed, it reveals the sky through its curved panes; open, it leaves the center of the dining room directly beneath the sky. Dark dining islands and warm, low table lamps make this dramatic room feel intimate.
role: Concept and creative direction: project narrative, guest journey, spatial idea, material and color palette, lighting direction, and art direction of the concept visualisations.

sections.heading: Spaces and elements
sections.body: Arrival threshold; main dining hall; perimeter window booths; central bar; transparent floor and water setting; operable glass half-dome; material and lighting palettes.
